name: just-in-time session start
probe: observe session events with an empty queue and then admit one job
pass: no Colab session exists while the queue is empty; session creation starts only after a job is admitted

name: parallel source and model warm-up
probe: record source_download_start, model_load_start, source_ready and model_ready monotonic timestamps
pass: source download and model loading start within 5 seconds of each other and overlap for a positive duration
forbidden: download completes before model loading starts

name: bounded warm reuse
probe: submit a second job within 30 seconds after the first job releases its lease
pass: the second job reuses the same session id and does not repeat session creation
forbidden: stop session immediately after every call

name: timely idle shutdown
probe: leave queue, inflight count and lease empty after a job
pass: the session is confirmed stopped between 30 and 45 seconds after becoming idle

name: inflight and lease protection
probe: cross the idle budget while a worker is inflight or its lease heartbeat is fresh
pass: the watchdog does not stop the session until inflight is zero, queue is empty and the lease is stale

name: shutdown failure retry and accounting
probe: make the first colab stop command fail and observe the next watchdog tick
pass: stop is retried within 15 seconds; failure and final stop timestamps are recorded for billable runtime accounting
forbidden: reset idle timer after failed stop
